open_points.subject: A04 capture input-reference classification
open_points.text: “Any FileFactsRef, including an empty file list, is refused” and “StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef continue”, while M23 says file inputs are references to SpooledFiles “by their facts”.
open_points.question: What exactly distinguishes a FileFactsRef from a SpooledFilesRef, particularly when a many-file input is empty and contains no individual file identity or location?
options: The reference has an explicit variant tag fixed by its provenance.
The reference kind is inferred from its fields.
Every empty many-file reference is FileFactsRef.
Every empty many-file reference from a run is SpooledFilesRef.
open_points.default_guess: Use an explicit tagged variant; an empty list derived from a run is SpooledFilesRef.

open_points.subject: A04 capture provenance
open_points.text: A15 says capture “copies its inputs”, but the change says “The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract” and operates on “the complete input tuple”.
open_points.question: Must the callable derive the implementation and input tuple from the named NodeExecution, verify caller-supplied arguments equal that execution’s implementation and inputs, or trust caller-supplied references that may name different values or files?
options: Derive all of them from the NodeExecution.
Accept them as arguments but verify exact equality with the NodeExecution.
Trust the caller after its A15 checks.
open_points.default_guess: Derive them from the NodeExecution, or equivalently verify exact equality before capture.

open_points.subject: A04 FileFactsRef versus unknown-reference precedence
open_points.text: A16 says “A request naming a record that does not exist … is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks”, while A04 says the callable checks for FileFactsRef “before looking up any input value or spooled file”.
open_points.question: If one port contains FileFactsRef and another names a missing StoredValue or SpooledFile, which refusal must win, and do PortRef targets count as records directly named by the request under A16?
options: FileFactsRef wins without looking up any other input reference.
The missing referenced record wins as unknown_reference under A16.
A16 applies only to the execution, run, implementation and contract named by the outer request, not to PortRefs.
open_points.default_guess: Treat PortRef resolution as local input validation, so FileFactsRef wins before any StoredValue or SpooledFile lookup.

open_points.subject: A04 FileFactsRef versus tuple-fit validation
open_points.text: The callable “checks the complete input tuple for facts-only file references” and then StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef “continue through the existing fit, size and copy checks”; A04 rule 1 otherwise orders port checks as “presence, carriage, schema, then size”.
open_points.question: When the tuple is incomplete, has an extra port, or uses FileFactsRef on a port whose declared carriage is value, does the FileFactsRef refusal occur before completeness and carriage checks, or only after the tuple has been shown to fit the contract?
options: Scan every supplied reference for FileFactsRef before all tuple-fit checks.
Check tuple presence and port membership first, then scan for FileFactsRef.
Run the existing presence and carriage checks completely before the FileFactsRef rule.
open_points.default_guess: Check the tuple’s port membership and completeness first, then refuse the first FileFactsRef before resolving referenced data.

open_points.subject: A04 contract-version comparison
open_points.text: “The callable first resolves the executed implementation, then checks its contract version against the named version.”
open_points.question: What is the “named version”: an explicit capture target supplied to the callable, the contract version pinned by the NodeExecution’s flow node, or the contract version already carried by the resolved implementation, and must all three agree when more than one is present?
options: It is an explicit target contract version and it must also equal the NodeExecution’s pinned version.
It is the NodeExecution’s pinned contract version; no separate target is accepted.
Only the resolved implementation’s own contract version is relevant.
open_points.default_guess: Use the NodeExecution’s pinned contract version as the target and require any explicit target to equal it.
